reproduction: User inputs message, TTS speaks, but assistant chat bubble remains visually empty in chat container.
root_cause: stream_started was called at the end of Turn 2 or not wired to initialize the text container before tokens arrived, leaving the bubble blank.
exploitability_impact: Assistant responses were invisible to the user despite being synthesized by the model.
repair: Connected stream_started early in query_llm, throttled markdown rendering in ChatBubble, and ensured raw_text correctly renders in text_browser.
evidence: PASSED in test_chat_bubble_throttled_markdown_rendering and live visual verification.

reproduction: Execute smart skill 'open note pad and type FRIDAY IS TESTING CONTEXT' after another window has opened.
root_cause: Window activation and focus transition timing was only 150ms, causing SendKeys to fail or Win11 multi-tab Notepad to return partial/stale UIA document ranges.
exploitability_impact: Automation missions involving fast app launches failed postcondition verification spuriously.
repair: Increased focus delay to 300ms, added edit.SetFocus() error handling, and verified injected text against last_typed cache.

reproduction: Run full test suite with PySide6 QThread workers executing heavy PDF extraction.
root_cause: PDFAnalysisWorker QThread was not joined with worker.wait() before Python garbage collection, leading to Windows fatal exception: access violation upon C++ QThread destruction.
exploitability_impact: Fatal process crash during asynchronous document analysis cleanup.
repair: Added explicit worker.wait(5000) calls across all QThread test loops ensuring full thread termination before scope exit.
evidence: PASSED (9/9 passed in test_pdf_concurrency_and_freeze.py without access violation).

reproduction: Send command 'What's the latest NVIDIA news?' with voice loop running in background.
root_cause: FridayVoiceLoop.run() emitted 'standby' on every phrase recording timeout, clobbering 'ACTIVE // THINKING' state to 'ACTIVE // LISTENING' on the HUD while query_llm was running.
exploitability_impact: HUD state displayed ACTIVE // LISTENING while model was actively thinking, leading user to believe assistant was stalled.
repair: Introduced self.is_generating flag in FridayBrain and guarded state_changed emission in voice loop and main window.
evidence: Verified HUD stays in THINKING mode while is_generating is True.

reproduction: Send multi-step tool command; UI showed zero response or status updates for 60-90s.
root_cause: stream_started signal was deferred until Turn 2 finished, and status_updated signals were dropped by ChatView because _is_generating was False.
exploitability_impact: User received zero visual feedback during model planning and tool execution turns.
repair: Emitted stream_started at the very start of query_llm with initial status, and updated status dynamically via status_updated during tool calls.
evidence: ChatBubble is staged immediately and displays live tool consultation updates.

reproduction: Call web_fetch or deep_research with 'http://169.254.169.254' or 'http://localhost' or file:// URLs.
root_cause: agent_tool_bridge.risk_gate lacked explicit validation for private RFC1918 IPs, loopback addresses, cloud metadata endpoints, and non-HTTP schemes.
exploitability_impact: Server-side request forgery (SSRF), local network scanning, and unauthorized local file retrieval via web tools.
repair: Added comprehensive IP and scheme validation in risk_gate, rejecting non-HTTP schemes, loopback, cloud metadata, and private IP ranges with fail-closed status.
evidence: PASSED (all SSRF and path traversal attack vectors blocked with BLOCKED status).

reproduction: App startup with 34 registered tools incurs a blocking 23s test_echo probe on cold start every launch.
root_cause: _tool_capability_cache was volatile in-memory only and re-probed on every launch.
exploitability_impact: User experienced an unnecessary 23-second cold start delay on the first query after every application start.
repair: Persisted verified tool capability status to settings ('model_tool_capability_cache'), loading at startup and invalidating on explicit model change.
evidence: Verified cache hit eliminates 23s probe overhead on subsequent runs.

reproduction: Execute deep research on queries with zero search hits, or observe page extraction targeting private IP addresses, or trigger synthesis HTTP error.
root_cause: 1) DeepResearchWorker proceeded to neural synthesis with empty sources, hallucinating ungrounded dossiers; 2) DeepResearchWorker had hardcoded fallback to llama3.2:1b; 3) fetch_page_content in engine.py lacked SSRF validation.
exploitability_impact: Ungrounded claim hallucination when searches returned zero hits; silent model substitution violating configured model directive; SSRF/internal network exposure during page text extraction.
repair: 1) Enforced zero-source fail-closed check returning honest inconclusive dossier without LLM hallucination; 2) Removed silent fallback to llama3.2:1b and dynamically resolved configured model from settings; 3) Added is_safe_url SSRF guard and _NO_REDIRECT_OPENER to fetch_page_content.
evidence: PASSED (all 20 tests pass in test_phase11_deep_research.py & test_research_lifecycle_forensics.py; AUDIT/RUNTIME_EVIDENCE/RESEARCH_HANG_FIXED.json passes with 10 verified sources and qwen3.5:9b).
